001package guiLessons;
002
003import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
004import java.io.DataOutputStream;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.nio.file.Files;
007import java.nio.file.Path;
008import java.util.zip.CRC32;
009import java.util.zip.DeflaterOutputStream;
010import javafx.scene.Node;
011import javafx.scene.image.PixelReader;
012import javafx.scene.image.WritableImage;
013
014/** Writes actual JavaFX node snapshots as PNG evidence without extra GUI dependencies. */
015final class LessonTestEvidence {
016
017        /** Prevents instantiation of this utility class. */
018        private LessonTestEvidence() { }
019
020        /**
021         * Captures a laid-out node on the JavaFX Application Thread as an opaque RGB PNG.
022         * @param node rendered scene root or dialog pane
023         * @param destination output PNG path
024         * @throws IOException if creating the output directory or writing the image fails
025         */
026        static void capture(Node node, Path destination) throws IOException {
027                node.applyCss();
028                if (node instanceof javafx.scene.Parent parent) parent.layout();
029                WritableImage image = node.snapshot(null, null);
030                int width = (int) image.getWidth();
031                int height = (int) image.getHeight();
032                PixelReader pixels = image.getPixelReader();
033                ByteArrayOutputStream compressed = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
034                try (DeflaterOutputStream deflater = new DeflaterOutputStream(compressed)) {
035                        for (int row = 0; row < height; row++) {
036                                deflater.write(0);
037                                for (int column = 0; column < width; column++) {
038                                        int color = pixels.getArgb(column, row);
039                                        deflater.write((color >> 16) & 255);
040                                        deflater.write((color >> 8) & 255);
041                                        deflater.write(color & 255);
042                                }
043                        }
044                }
045                Files.createDirectories(destination.toAbsolutePath().getParent());
046                try (DataOutputStream output = new DataOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(destination))) {
047                        output.writeLong(0x89504e470d0a1a0aL);
048                        ByteArrayOutputStream header = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
049                        try (DataOutputStream dimensions = new DataOutputStream(header)) {
050                                dimensions.writeInt(width);
051                                dimensions.writeInt(height);
052                                dimensions.write(new byte[] {8, 2, 0, 0, 0});
053                        }
054                        chunk(output, "IHDR", header.toByteArray());
055                        chunk(output, "IDAT", compressed.toByteArray());
056                        chunk(output, "IEND", new byte[0]);
057                }
058        }
059
060        /**
061         * Writes one PNG chunk with its required CRC.
062         * @param output image stream
063         * @param type four-letter PNG chunk type
064         * @param data chunk payload
065         * @throws IOException if writing fails
066         */
067        private static void chunk(DataOutputStream output, String type, byte[] data) throws IOException {
068                byte[] typeBytes = type.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
069                CRC32 checksum = new CRC32();
070                checksum.update(typeBytes);
071                checksum.update(data);
072                output.writeInt(data.length);
073                output.write(typeBytes);
074                output.write(data);
075                output.writeInt((int) checksum.getValue());
076        }
077}
